name: @projexlight/sdk-conversation
summary: Multi-turn conversation substrate for ProjexCloud: organize messages into Sessions (per-tenant + per-(patient,provider) or per-(customer,agent)), track Turns (human + AI), and support Handoffs (AI → human, agent → senior, async → sync). Backed by envelope-encrypted message bodies via sdk-vault; consumed by patient-portal secure messaging, support-bot chat, and the cloud-builder dialog.

events.name: conversation.session.opened.v1
events.description: New session opened between two or more personas. Carries channel kind (patient↔provider, customer↔agent, agent↔ai, cloud-builder).

events.name: conversation.turn.posted.v1
events.description: One turn added (human or AI). Encrypted body envelope ref + token usage if AI.

events.name: conversation.handoff.completed.v1
events.description: Handoff completed (AI → human or human → human). New owner persona attached to the session.

events.name: conversation.session.closed.v1
events.description: Session closed (resolved / abandoned / archived). Triggers retention-policy timer.

models.description: Session header: tenant_id, channel_kind, participants (persona ids), opened_at, closed_at, status.
One row per message: session_id, author_persona_id, author_kind (human / agent / system), body_envelope, body_dek_id, sent_at, redactions_applied[].
Per-handoff row: session_id, from_persona_id, to_persona_id, reason, completed_at.

hooks.name: openSession
hooks.description: Start a new conversation. Returns session_id; participants attached.

hooks.name: postTurn
hooks.description: Append a turn. Body is envelope-encrypted via sdk-vault before persistence.

hooks.name: requestHandoff
hooks.description: Request a handoff (AI → human, agent → senior). Pending until accepted.

hooks.name: acceptHandoff
hooks.description: New owner accepts; session.owner_persona updates; emits handoff.completed.v1.

hooks.name: closeSession
hooks.description: Mark closed with a resolution + retention policy id. Retention timer starts.

ui_components.name: ConversationView
ui_components.description: Threaded message view with handoff banner + AI-vs-human badge per turn.

scenarios.title: Patient ↔ provider secure messaging thread
scenarios.when_to_use: Patient-portal blueprint surface. Encrypted under tenant or encounter key; every message a chain-of-audit entry.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Session row + turn row written. Body envelope-encrypted; the conversation.turn row stores body_envelope + body_dek_id only. Audit chain entry per turn.

scenarios.title: AI bot answers first, escalates to a human after 3 turns
scenarios.when_to_use: Support flow — AI handles tier-1 questions, hands off to a human when it can't resolve or when the customer asks.
scenarios.expected_outcome: session.owner_persona transitions to the human agent. Customer sees a banner explaining the handoff. Emits conversation.handoff.completed.v1 for audit + ops.

scenarios.title: Cloud-builder agent uses this for its chat surface
scenarios.when_to_use: E6 cloud builder /build surface; conversation persists across page reloads via the session id.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Replayable build session — operator can later inspect every prompt + response in the conversation, paired with the matching audit + MCP tool-call trail.

scenarios.title: AI turn linked back to its ai-gateway completion
scenarios.when_to_use: Compliance / debugging — given a turn from the AI, reconstruct exactly which provider + prompt + tokens produced it.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Turn carries completion_id. Operator can join conversation.turn ↔ ai_gateway.completion to get the full provenance — prompt, model, redactions, usage. Satisfies EU AI Act Annex IV.

scenarios.title: Closed session → retention timer fires after policy window
scenarios.when_to_use: Patient-provider sessions retained 7 years (HIPAA); cloud-builder sessions retained 30 days. Both driven by retention policy id at session close.
scenarios.expected_outcome: session.closed_at + retention_policy_id set. Background worker walks sessions past retention; encrypts + cold-stores, then shreds the DEK so bodies become undecryptable.

compliance_posture.notes: Message bodies envelope-encrypted via sdk-vault at-rest. AI turns carry the completion_id for EU AI Act per-turn provenance. Retention timers strictly enforced — shredding the DEK at retention expiry is irreversible (BYOK Variant A tenants control their own DEK).

pricing_skus.unit_description: per GB-month of retained-after-close body storage
